caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical mug with a handle on the right side, positioned upright against a plain, light beige background. The mug's body is decorated with floral patterns in a palette of orange, yellow, blue, and green, with accents of brown outlining some shapes and details. The flowers and leaves are distributed evenly around the visible surface of the mug, creating a colorful and dense ornamental design. The rim at the top and the base of the mug are accented by thin brown lines. The interior of the mug is a pale light blue or grayish shade. There is a slight shadow beneath and to the left of the mug, suggesting a light source from the upper right. The mug is centered in the composition, and to the lower right of the mug, the name "GEORGE BERNHARD MEYER" is printed in small, neat letters.
title: Mug
